limits.description: Only the original 1647 English source witness checked; no collation with printer manuscript, earlier medical notes or second-edition emendations.
Julian/Old-Style date is contextual inference from 1645 England and printed Die Mercurij; the source does not print Julian or Gregorian.
Clock 7:22 A.M. and hor ♄ are distinct; no printed longitude, timezone, UT offset or verified astronomical hour conversion.
Some wheel degree and astrology glyphs are not fully legible and no full chart position table has been independently reconstructed.
Printed glyph afflicting Aquarius sixth house reads Dragon-tail ☋; orientation remains copy-qualified; Venus/Mars alternatives are unsupported.
Moon near Mars is source wording, not a measured exact conjunction or established orb.
The identity of Cauda Leonis is not established by this passage; do not silently convert to Cauda Draconis, lunar node or Denebola.
Sun perfect square Saturn and other figure conditions are authorial printed claims, not independently verified astronomical calculations.
How signs of long ascensions convert a source sextile to more properly a square needs a specified historical convention.
Mars only partly or almost eighth lord in printed wording; its exact share or house system not independently established.
Translation of virtue from Mercury to Jupiter under lunar separation requires missing detailed timing/aspect mechanics and independent ephemeris.
Physiological spleen, bowel, head, sleep, fevers and pulse descriptions are astrological inferred diagnoses, not medical examinations.
All which was true is Lilly’s own retrospective confirmation; no outside observer or dated medical record.
Claimed warning of ten or twelve days is authored retrospectively in a 1647 publication about 1645 events. No contemporaneous prediction freeze.
Patient identity and death date July28 are not independently authenticated, so timing congruence is internal to the author narrative.
A 12-day calendar difference from July16 to July28 is arithmetic; it does not establish unique or untouched predictive performance.
After-death Mercury/Sun/Saturn and Moon/Sun transits may have been selected after the reported outcome and are not initial frozen targets.
Printed after-death phrase says Moon transiting SIXTH house, viz 14 of Aquarius; wheel sixth cusp near 13°32′ Aquarius. Ordinal 14th degree or rounding possible but unverified.
The parenthetical Latin on Sun temporal light/vital force is retained without forced translation or extra independent rule.
Historical death-risk, humoral cause and religious/estate advice are source documentation only, not actionable medical guidance.
Chapter XLVI case is separate from the May8 doctor case in Chapter XLV; no evidence that the two depict the same patient.
Several features reuse Virgo ascending, Mars, Moon and Saturn; they cannot be statistically counted as independent observations.
Original errata leaf PDF888 has no correction for printed289/290 but is selective; PDF324 is printed290, not printed324.
No natal birth chart, independent longitudinal follow-up, modern chart parity or trained probability calibration has been provided.
Original wheel degree/glyph readings provisional, not ephemeris parity.
Printed July28 leading digit imperfect; no independently authenticated death date.
Ten-or-twelve-day warning has no printed start moment; counting from enquiry date is editorial.
Cauda Leonis named point separate from Dragon-tail glyph of Aquarius sixth.
His vertue in fourth reason has an uncertain pronoun antecedent, probably Mercury.
Post-death Moon opposition target glyph is blotched; Sun reading qualified.
After-death Sun/Saturn square does not specify if Saturn is radical or transiting.
Wheel sixth cusp 13°32′ Aquarius and prose 14 Aquarius not automatically equivalent.
Manuscript annotations or ruled lines on copy not attributed to Lilly.
All significators promise no less than death is author rationale, not calibrated outcome evidence.
No derivation of exact ten/twelve day limit printed.
Antecedent of that house and Signe in the opening remains ambiguous.
